title: RAMALS MVP-2 DiagnosticProbeProposal v1 (M2-ADR-032)
description: An advisory, non-authoritative recommendation for ONE next diagnostic evidence-acquisition probe. It asserts nothing about the learner: it names an unresolved evidentiary ambiguity in governed H6/H7 evidence and a bounded next observation that would help discriminate it. It is never a diagnosis, a classification, a ranking of misconceptions, a confidence value, or an instruction to run anything. Java's deterministic, versioned, fail-closed gate (DiagnosticProbeProposalGate) independently decides whether it has any effect; probe eligibility and execution remain with DIAGNOSTIC_SELECTION_V1-V5, untouched. Its own contract version, independent of diagnostic-proposal.v1.schema.json.

proposalType.description: Explicit discriminator (M2-ADR-032 22). Distinguishes this evidence-acquisition recommendation from the skill-classification DiagnosticAssessmentProposal; one field never means two verdict shapes.

interactionId.description: Echoed for cross-check only. Java binds the authoritative interaction from its own context and rejects a mismatch; a value here can never select or override the interaction (M2-ADR-032 4.3).

domain.description: The domain the recommendation concerns. Cross-checked against the interaction's authorized domain; never widens scope (M2-ADR-032 4.4, 21).

targetMisconceptionId.description: An existing, already-authored, PUBLISHED core.misconception id (M2-ADR-026 4). Must be a member of the misconception id set actually exposed to this interaction (M_allowed) and is independently re-validated by Java (M2-ADR-032 12). The AI may never name or infer a misconception that does not already exist.

targetNode.description: The single ontology entity the target misconception is attached to, per M2-ADR-026's DB-enforced exclusive arc. Must exactly match the misconception's real target (kind and id); it is not chosen freely.

probeIntent.description: A bounded, closed set of advisory intents. Versioned with this contract. Neither value asserts a diagnosis, a probability, or that a probe is eligible to run.

candidateProbeRef.description: Optional. A specific authored probe/assessment object the agent believes would serve the intent. If present it must be a member of the probe-reference set authorized for this interaction; naming it is never itself authorization to run it (M2-ADR-032 13). Eligibility is decided only by deterministic Java selection policy, which this contract does not touch.

evidenceRefs.description: E_proposed: governed evidence/provenance identifiers the recommendation cites. Java enforces E_proposed subset of E_allowed - the exact set supplied to this interaction - independently of the prompt (M2-ADR-032 11). A reference outside E_allowed is rejected outright.

rationale.description: Bounded natural language stating why additional evidence would be diagnostically useful. Matches Diagnosis.reason's 1000-character bound. Must not contain probability/percentage language, comparative 'more/less likely' between misconceptions, or resolution terminology (VERIFIED/CONFIRMED/RESOLVED/CURED/RECURRENCE/REGRESSION/REVERSAL/ROOT_CAUSE) - Java rejects it lexically and deterministically (M2-ADR-032 8, 9; M2-ADR-030 G).
